name: Super Smash Bros. Ultimate
short_description: A party platform fighter: knock friends off the stage instead of draining a health bar.
sources: oracle study 2026-10-23 (public knowledge, no store fetch, no game files)
summary: A party platform fighter: knock friends off the stage instead of draining a health bar.

identity.core_loop: Run, jump, attack; every hit raises the other fighter's damage number, and high damage means they fly further; push them off the edge.
identity.ui_and_game_feel: Chaotic, bouncy, funny; four players and items make every match different.

hud_coverage.method: Oracle study from public knowledge of the game, in our own words; not yet measured on capture

information_grammar.note: One number per player at the bottom of the screen; the bigger it is the further you fly. Fighters flash and smoke when they are in danger, and a big hit freezes the screen for a moment.

identity.art_direction: Each fighter keeps their own home look, held together by strong rim light, bloom and one shared hit-spark language.

rendering.signature: Every fighter keeps their own home look; one strong rim light, bright bloom and a shared hit-spark style make them belong to one game.
rendering.source: oracle rendering study 2026-10-23 (public knowledge, no captures, no game files)
rendering.lesson: Mixed styles can live together if light, rim and effects are shared. Useful for Abbie's World characters made by different factories.

identity.audio_mood: Huge library of upbeat remixes; loud bright hit sounds.
identity.lessons_for_abbies_world: Push-off-the-edge beats health bars for kids: nobody 'dies', they fly away and come back. Danger shows on the fighter, not in a meter.
